 Television DC Correspondent 12 Nov 2026 12:26 PM IST 12 Nov 2026 12:26 PM IST Now, Scout Op’s bald look is going viral on social media.
 x Scout Op. As Preferred
Source Popular contestant Scout Op needs no introduction. He has a huge fan following outside the house. Scout Op has always been trending on social media, whether for fights with other contestants or his bond with Love Gill.
 The latest news doing the rounds on social media is that Scout Op has changed his look; he trimmed his hair and went completely bald. Now, Scout Op’s bald look is going viral on social media.
 We are not sure why Scout Op went bald, but here are a few tweets that could give a possible hint about his new look.
 Take a look at the tweets: 
 🚨 DID SCOUT GOES BALD AFTER FIGHT WITH LOVE? After Love confronted Scout and told him to behave and maintain some tameez, Qazi also called him out over his remark on Pyjama Nada. Scout tried to defend himself, saying, “Mera waise koi woh matlab nahi tha.” But things took an unexpected turn just minutes later! Frustrated after the entire incident, Scout went to the washroom and TRIMMED OFF ALL HIS HAIR, leaving everyone shocked with his completely BALD new look! 😱
— BBTak (@BiggBoss_Tak) November 11, 2026 🚨 BIGG BOSS 20 UPDATE 🚨 Nobody is talking to #ScoutOP ! He has no friends left in the house. Even Love is not talking to him now. Last night, he climbed a tree and hid stolen items in the Danube property area.
